name: throughline-skills
description: Claude Code skills for working in throughline IDD requirements repositories.

plugins.name: tl
plugins.description: Skills for working in throughline IDD requirements repositories: /tl:shape initialises a graph by a structured discovery conversation instead of tl init's register guess, /tl:challenge runs the challenge pass tl check cannot, /tl:multigraph manages a repository holding more than one graph, /tl:reconcile checks code against its graph through citations written in the code, and /tl:assess records an objective assessment of a piece of work when it reaches done.
